messages:
Claire D: Quick kickoff 1 Partner Y wants EU-first staged cutover with an A/B ranking check and strict telemetry. Need flag name, canary slices, A/B plan, rollback gates, legal on payload samples.
Omar H: Proposed flow: micro-canary 4% random for 2h -> EU 25% for 12h -> EU 60% for 24h -> hold. Also run a parallel A/B 50/50 on a 10k request sample window during the EU 25% phase to validate ranking quality. Block marketing during windows.
Ben R: Eng notes: we'll pin `py_partnery.eu.q3` (quantized). Pre-warm EU pools and enable prefix/KV cache warming. Flag suggestion: `partnery.eu.optin.v1.ab`. Console payload snippet for canary:
```
{"canary":[{"slice":"rand-4pct","dur":"2h"},{"slice":"eu-25pct","dur":"12h"},{"slice":"eu-60pct","dur":"24h"}],"ab_test":{"enabled":true,"split":"50-50","sample_size":10000},"fallback":"model-global-stable"}
```
Kira L: SRE gates (auto-rollback): 1) 5xx rate >0.8% sustained for 180s; 2) p95 latency >2.2s for 300s; 3) A/B semantic-quality delta worse by >3% vs baseline on customer gold set. Auto-rollback sequence: disable new flag slice -> route traffic to `model-global-stable` -> scale down new variant -> page oncall. We'll also expose a manual kill-switch in Console that flips within <25s.
Ava S: CS ask: Partner Y requires daily telemetry for T+1..T+3 and then every 72h for two weeks. They want per-tenant latency histogram, success rate, sample counts, and up to 200 sanitized samples/day during first 48h. Also a webhook into their staging Slack for daily A/B summary.
LegalBot: Legal ok with 14-day retention for raw samples and 90-day aggregates. Must remove PII and hash identifiers. DPA addendum required before sharing samples/webhooks.
Ben R: We'll implement sample masking and a sanitized schema. Console can deliver webhook to their staging channel; we'll scope API key with rotation every 7 days. Eng-Platform to provide the schema before signoff.
Omar H: Ops constraints: pre-authorize emergency +35% burst capacity for first 4h; no promos/campaigns during canary windows; Ops will run the cutover if signoffs complete. Recommend cutover Tuesday 08:00 UTC.
Kira L: I'll run kill-switch and rollback automation tests in staging tomorrow 15:00 UTC and post logs here. Please tag SRE on any unexpected behavior.
deploy-bot: checkpoint saved: canary-plan/partnery-eu/1775550000 by Claire D
Claire D: Actions: Product -> draft telemetry appendix + DPA draft; Eng-Platform -> flag + webhook + prewarm plan + sample schema; SRE -> SLOs, rollback automation, kill-switch test; Ops -> schedule cutover and capacity. Please sign off by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
